name: B10-0575/2025 (Renew) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the military takeover in Guinea-Bissau on 26 November 2025, which stopped an election before results were released. The Parliament condemns the coup, demands that detained people be freed, and asks for the election process to be finished peacefully so the real winner can be announced. It also warns that drug trafficking money has deeply penetrated the country's political and military institutions.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Guinea-Bissau's military leaders, detained politicians and officials, and voters whose election result is unresolved.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the European Union Council and Commission, West African and African Union bodies, and Guinea-Bissau's authorities, who are urged to act on it.
